character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A small green-skinned goblin archer, wiry and alert, long pointed ears, a dented leather cap with round red-lensed brass goggles over its eyes. Holds a short curved wooden bow in its left hand, a leather quiver of feathered arrows on its back. Patched brown leathers, a deep blue academy cloth scarf with a gold star worn as a trophy, bare clawed feet. Warm earthy colours: olive green skin, brown leather, brass, deep blue cloth. Detailed pixel art, dark outline.
